_comment: Machine-readable spec for the Spiceto Biryani Whole Spices Meta campaign. Values marked {{...}} must be filled before this can be used to create the campaign. Nothing here has been created in the ad account yet.

product.name: Biryani Whole Spices - Khada Garam Masala

campaign.name: SPICETO | Traffic | Prospecting | IN-Metro
campaign._url_tags_note: Meta dynamic URL parameters — they fill in per ad and per placement instead of being hardcoded. Passed via the tool's `url_tags` argument, appended to the landing page URL on every click. IMPORTANT: Amazon does not report UTM values anywhere in Seller Central, so these measure NOTHING while the destination is Amazon. They are set up correctly now so they work the day traffic is routed through spiceto.in. Real measurement options are ranked in measurement.md.

shared_targeting._geo_note: Meta location keys below were resolved live via search_meta_targeting against the real ad account on 2026-08-05. Pass each as {key, type, radius, distance_unit} in the `locations` array. Three keys are still unresolved - the Adspirer quota ran out mid-lookup. Resolve them with search_meta_targeting before creating the campaign; do NOT guess a key.

custom_locations.note: covers Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad - do not add separately

shared_targeting._gender_rationale: All genders for the first 7 days, then narrow on the Ads Manager gender breakdown. See targeting.md for the full reasoning.

targeting._interest_note: All IDs below were resolved live against the real ad account on 2026-08-05. Searches for 'Biryani', 'Garam masala', 'Masala', 'Spice' and 'Herbs and spices' returned ZERO results - those interests do not exist in Meta's catalogue, so the stack leans on general cooking/cuisine interests instead. 'Amazon.in' also does not exist; 'Amazon.com' does and is what Indian users are tagged with.

flexible_spec._layer: 2 - NARROW: must also match ANY of

ads.angle: aroma - ground spice loses its oils, restaurants grind fresh
ads.headline: Grind It Fresh. Taste The Difference.
ads._destination_note: Swap for the Amazon Attribution URL for ad A1 once Brand Registry is in place. UTMs are carried by campaign.url_tags, not hardcoded here.

ads.angle: provenance - Kerala spice country, Ernakulam based
ads.headline: Kerala Spices. Whole, Not Ground.
ads._destination_note: Swap for the Amazon Attribution URL for ad A3 once Brand Registry is in place.

review_schedule.day_3: delivery and rejection check only - no optimisation, learning phase
review_schedule.day_7: CPLPV by ad, ad set, gender, age, city. Pause dead ads. Make the gender call.
review_schedule.day_14: Meta + first Amazon Attribution data. Cut bottom cities. Pick winning angle.
review_schedule.day_21: Attributed sales and CPA vs break-even. Scale, restructure, or stop.

blockers_before_launch: CREATIVE IMAGE: no Spiceto asset identified. The ad account holds 1417 images and 884 videos across multiple clients (scire.co.in, FOREST and others); the Spiceto pack shot could not be identified from metadata alone, and the fbcdn thumbnail URLs are unreachable from this environment. Needs either a public image URL or the specific image_hash.
ADSPIRER QUOTA: 15/15 free calls used as of 2026-08-05. Resets 2026-09-04. Campaign creation cannot proceed until quota is available.
3 unresolved Meta location keys: Chennai, Indore, Ahmedabad
{{PRICE}} and {{PACK_SIZE}} unknown - amazon.in and spiceto.in both returned HTTP 403 from this environment
{{IG_ACCOUNT_ID}} not supplied (facebook_page_id auto-detects from the connected account)

Creative assets not produced (9 files: see creative-brief.md)
Amazon listing not yet audited against launch-checklist.md
creation_sequence: 1. create_meta_image_campaign - creates campaign + ad set A + ad A1 in one call. Pass campaign_budget_optimization=true, budget_daily=500, objective=OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, call_to_action=SHOP_NOW, locations=<the 12 objects above>, location_types=['home'], age_min=25, age_max=54, genders=null (all), interests/behaviors=<layer 1 + 2>, advantage_audience=true.
2. add_meta_ad_set - ad set B (Broad). Pass campaign_budget_optimization=true, NO budget_daily, same locations, no interests, advantage_audience=true.
3. add_meta_ad x4 - ads A2 and A3 into each of the two ad sets.
NOTE: never call create_meta_image_campaign twice - each call creates a SEPARATE campaign.
Everything is created PAUSED by default.
